notes.title: Playism Publisher Sale starts now!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8438467/5063e9f11e0d7186674f4118450f0768365be75f.jpg[/img]

To celebrate the release of Gensokyo Night Festival and the soundtrack of Touhou Luna Nights on October 14th, as well as the release of the English update and soundtrack of Lost Technology on the 15th, we are happy to announce the Playism Publisher Sale!  
＊The soundract of Touhou Luna Nights is currently 10% off!

As it is a Publisher Sale, the discount rate is higher than the usual sales!

YUMENIKKI -DREAM DIARY- is 80% off!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/774811/YUMENIKKI_DREAM_DIARY/

Ace of Seafood is 70% off! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/450500/Ace_of_Seafood/

Discover the full version of Forget Me Not: My Organic Garden. A mini scenario has been added in April!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/363980/Forget_Me_Not_My_Organic_Garden/

Take a look at the other titles:
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/Playism/list/51161

The sale will only last one week, please check it out!
